prompt: give top 5 products that need to be  restocked in may for sales in june and july according to sales trends across all stores
title: May Restock Priorities
summary: Identify the top 5 products that should be restocked in May to support sales in June and July, based on sales trends across all stores. Focus on products with strong seasonal demand, rising trends, or recurring stock pressure.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS sales_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)::int AS sales_month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_item_rows,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(oi.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (2, 3, 4, 5)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.category_id,
    p.type_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_units_sold,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_revenue
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-02-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-08-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
)
SELECT *
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY monthly_units_sold DESC, monthly_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_units_sold,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_revenue
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-02-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-08-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), product_totals AS (
  SELECT product_id, product_name, sku, SUM(monthly_units_sold) AS total_units_sold
  FROM monthly_sales
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_totals
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY rn;

WITH top_products AS (
  SELECT 24 AS product_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 17 UNION ALL
  SELECT 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 27
), monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_units_sold,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_revenue
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-02-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-08-01'
    AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top_products)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT *
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY product_id, month;

WITH top_products AS (
  SELECT 24 AS product_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 17 UNION ALL
  SELECT 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 27
)
SELECT
  i.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.is_online,
  i.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  i.stock_level
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = i.store_id
JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM top_products)
ORDER BY i.product_id, i.stock_level ASC, i.store_id;
